description: Change fields of a client of the connected facturo account. Pass ONLY the fields the user asked to change; omitted fields stay untouched, an empty string clears a field (not client_name or country). Read the change back to the user (old and new value) and wait for their OK first. A new UID is checked against VIES before it is saved. Documents already created keep the client data they were created with.

client_name.description: Company or person name as printed on documents

country.description: Two-letter country code (AT, DE, CH, IT ...), default AT

name_line2.description: Second address line (contact person, department, c/o)

payment_terms.description: Payment terms printed for this client, e.g. 'Zahlbar innerhalb von 14 Tagen'

name: update_client
title: Kunde ändern
